item.caption:
Three days until Election Day! 🗳️

Before heading to the polls, here are a few friendly reminders:

1️⃣ Double-check your polling location. Showing up at the right place is a great start.

2️⃣ Bring an accepted, unexpired photo ID—such as an Ohio driver license or state ID, U.S. passport, or qualifying military ID.

3️⃣ Leave campaign shirts, hats and buttons at home. The polling place is a campaign-free zone—even if your outfit is really convincing.

4️⃣ Be patient and kind to the poll workers. They’re helping keep everything moving!

5️⃣ Polls are open from 6:30 a.m. until 7:30 p.m. If you’re in line by 7:30, stay in line.

6️⃣ And finally—under no circumstances, absolutely none whatsoever, forget to vote Joe Darwal for Judge!

#JoeDarwalForJudge #VoteJoeDarwal #SummitCounty #ElectionDay #OhioVotes

3 days until Election Day!

Did you know? If you forgot to sign your vote by mail ballot envelope or your signature doesn’t match your voter record, your ballot can still be fixed and counted!

If you receive a letter from the Elections office about a missing or unmatched signature, follow the instructions and return your completed statement by 5:00 p.m. on November 25, 2026, to ensure your ballot will be counted.

The signature you provide on the completed statement may be added to your voter registration record for signature comparisons in future elections.

Want to see what the letter looks like? See a sample at https://ow.ly/IJXE5102jwS. 

#TulareCounty #ElectionDay #Vote

item.caption:
🗳️💙 I VOTED! ✅🙌

What a great feeling to cast my ballot right here in East Providence! And yes, I even got my “I VOTED” sticker! 😁🗳️

Now it's your turn, Ward 2! 💙

Election Day is almost here, but you don't have to wait until Tuesday to make your voice heard!

🚨 EARLY VOTING IS STILL OPEN! 🚨

📍 East Providence City Hall
145 Taunton Avenue, First Floor

🗓️ TODAY, Saturday, October 31: 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM

🗓️ Monday, November 2: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

🗳 Election Day: Tuesday, November 3
🕖 Polls are open 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM at your assigned polling location.

✅ Don't forget to bring your photo ID!

📸 I've also included a sample ballot showing the candidates and ballot questions I'm supporting in this election. I wanted to share my choices with everyone and give you a chance to see where I stand.

Serving our community and representing the families of Ward 2 has been an incredible honor. I'm grateful for all the conversations, encouragement, friendships, and support I've received throughout this campaign. 💙

With just a few days left, I'm asking everyone to please take a little time to get out and vote. Every vote matters, especially in our local elections, where the decisions made have a direct impact on our schools, neighborhoods, and community.

Whether you've already voted, plan to vote early, or will be heading to the polls Tuesday, thank you for making your voice heard! 🗳💙

And if you've already voted, drop a 🗳️ or 💙 in the comments! I'd love to see how many of our Ward 2 neighbors have voted!

Let's finish strong, Ward 2! 💪💙

#IVoted #VoteEarly #Ward2 #EastProvidence #Election2026 YourVoteMatters GetOutTheVote CommunityFirst EveryVoteCounts TonyDeSimas election 2026Elections

item.caption:
🗳️💙 I VOTED! ✅🙌

What a great feeling to cast my ballot right here in East Providence! And yes, I even got my “I VOTED” sticker! 😁🗳️

Now it's your turn, Ward 2! 💙

Election Day is almost here, but you don't have to wait until Tuesday to make your voice heard!

🚨 EARLY VOTING IS STILL OPEN! 🚨

📍 East Providence City Hall
145 Taunton Avenue, First Floor

🗓️ TODAY, Saturday, October 31: 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM

🗓️ Monday, November 2: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

🗳 Election Day: Tuesday, November 3
🕖 Polls are open 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM at your assigned polling location.

✅ Don't forget to bring your photo ID!

📸 I've also included a sample ballot showing the candidates and ballot questions I'm supporting in this election. I wanted to share my choices with everyone and give you a chance to see where I stand.

Serving our community and representing the families of Ward 2 has been an incredible honor. I'm grateful for all the conversations, encouragement, friendships, and support I've received throughout this campaign. 💙

With just a few days left, I'm asking everyone to please take a little time to get out and vote. Every vote matters, especially in our local elections, where the decisions made have a direct impact on our schools, neighborhoods, and community.

Whether you've already voted, plan to vote early, or will be heading to the polls Tuesday, thank you for making your voice heard! 🗳💙

And if you've already voted, drop a 🗳️ or 💙 in the comments! I'd love to see how many of our Ward 2 neighbors have voted!

Let's finish strong, Ward 2! 💪💙

#IVoted #VoteEarly #Ward2 #EastProvidence #Election2026 YourVoteMatters GetOutTheVote CommunityFirst EveryVoteCounts TonyDeSimas election 2026Elections

Trump's rallies are back — and so is the legal fight over the vote 🗳️
He cancelled Kansas and Iowa on Thursday. By Friday, both were back on for Sunday.
At the same time, his Justice Department is fighting in court over Alaska's Senate race and California's ballots.
And a record 47.9 million Americans have already voted.
Who decides this election — voters, or the courts? 👇
